title: Credential-Breach Exposure Alert
dataSources: Breach alerts (`breach:alert`), inbox stats (`inbox:stats`), cloud-drive usage (`clouddrive:usage`), certificate expiry (`certexpiry:check`).
app: Personal cybersecurity feeds — Have-I-Been-Pwned breach alerts, personal email/inbox stats, cloud-storage usage APIs, and personal TLS-certificate expiry checks — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=breach:alert
| where notified="false"
| stats values(breach) as breaches, latest(_time) as seen by account
| sort - seen
description: Alerts when one of your email addresses shows up in a new data breach so you can change passwords fast.
value: Knowing you are in a breach within hours, not months, is the difference between a password change and account takeover.
implementation: Poll a breach-notification API into `index=personal`; alert on new exposures per account.
visualization: Table of accounts newly appearing in breaches.
grandmaExplanation: It warns you the moment your email turns up in a data breach, so you can change your password quickly.
